title: Nexus PoC multi-workstation topology

poc_product_boundary.experience: Nexus My Requests and My Tasks with status, approvals, notifications, recovery, and adverse states
poc_product_boundary.initial_behavior: Primarily read, status, and deep link with explicitly selected governed actions
poc_product_boundary.operating_posture: Enterprise production support and healthcare-grade identity, authorization, privacy, audit, observability, resilience, and recovery
poc_product_boundary.sequencing_rule: A Workday-first thin vertical slice proves integration mechanics but cannot reduce the full PoC acceptance boundary

authority_model.program_product_manager: Owns program outcomes, priority, value, and product-acceptance recommendations
authority_model.app_framework_chief_architect: Owns cross-workstream architecture, frozen contracts, shared seams, and technical standards
authority_model.program_flow_controller: Owns admission, WIP, dependency flow, assignments, escalation routing, and sole dashboard projection; material control turns require same-turn atomic projection and validation without product, architecture, source, merge, release, or risk authority
authority_model.integration_branch_manager: Owns integration order, conflicts, PR and CI evidence, accepted-base freshness, and worktree disposition
authority_model.workstream_lead_outcome_owner: Owns one bounded outcome, local priority, acceptance interpretation, dependencies, and escalation
authority_model.workstream_technical_lead: Owns workstream design, implementation plan, contract compliance, and focused proof
authority_model.branch_owner: Is the sole source writer for one assigned branch and worktree
authority_model.human_sponsor: Owns strategic ratification, material scope, sensitive risk, release, and production authority

scale_up_gates: No repeated conflicts across declared write roots
No more than two merge-ready branches waiting for integration
Two consecutive integration cycles retain attributable green evidence
scale_down_triggers: Two active producers require the same write root
A shared contract changes without one owner and freeze SHA
CI failures cannot be attributed to one producer branch
Products consume another worktree's source or local output

baseline_obligations: Preserve tenant, user, delegated-agent, request, and correlation identity
Keep authorization and governed-write enforcement server-side
Emit auditable decisions without PHI, secrets, or prompt payloads in logs
Expose OpenTelemetry-compatible traces, metrics, and structured events
Provide accessible keyboard, focus, reduced-motion, and screen-reader behavior
Fail safely when providers, intelligence, or network dependencies are unavailable

workstreams.name: PDS Experience System
workstreams.owns: F0/F1 tokens, typography, motion, layout, dimensions, React Aria adapters, components, and catalog
workstreams.delivers: Versioned self-contained PDS web package and catalog evidence
activation_gates: Ratified PDS experience dimensions and visual-language decisions are on the branch base
Connected Fabric baseline is preserved before component migration
Package consumption contract forbids product source aliases
publishes: Installable PDS component package with explicit version
Web and native tokens plus adaptation contracts
Catalog build, accessibility, interaction, and visual evidence

workstreams.name: PDS Health AI and Agentic Intelligence
workstreams.owns: Provider adapter, answer envelope, contextual chat, generated views, recommendations, evaluation, and fallback semantics
workstreams.delivers: Deterministic adapter plus live-ready integration package without UI component ownership
activation_gates: answer_envelope@1 and identity metadata are frozen
Generated-view metadata is provider-neutral
UI rendering remains owned by WS-01 and consuming products
publishes: Provider package and deterministic contract fixtures
answer_envelope@1 compatibility evidence
Evaluation, fallback, provenance, and error semantics

workstreams.name: Workday Integration
workstreams.owns: Bounded Workday status, read, and deep-link projection for the flagship journey
workstreams.delivers: Independent provider package and representative fixtures
activation_gates: Nexus journey operation list is bounded
Representative sanitized Workday fixtures are approved
Authentication and pagination contracts remain provider-package local
publishes: Workday provider package
Representative response, pagination, and fault fixtures
Read, status, and deep-link certification evidence

workstreams.name: Native Mobile
workstreams.owns: Expo and React Native task list/detail, approval, notifications, deep links, and interruption behavior
workstreams.delivers: Native application consuming shared semantics and tokens rather than web components
activation_gates: PDS native token projection and channel-neutral work contracts are frozen
Web layout is not treated as the mobile interaction contract
Offline and secure-storage posture is decided
publishes: Nexus native application artifact
Shared semantic-contract compatibility evidence
Device, interruption, notification, deep-link, and accessibility evidence

workstreams.name: ServiceNow Integration
workstreams.owns: Nexus-specific ServiceNow reads, status, deep links, approval/task projections, and one selected governed action
workstreams.delivers: Provider package, contract fixtures, and certification evidence
activation_gates: Nexus journey operation list is bounded
Governed action has explicit intent-preview and evidence requirements
Representative sanitized ServiceNow fixtures are approved
publishes: ServiceNow provider package
Representative task, approval, status, and deep-link fixtures
Selected governed-action certification evidence

workstreams.name: Product Evidence and PoC Readiness
workstreams.owns: Journey definition, representative data, usability, accessibility, outcome baseline, demo choreography, and support/runbook evidence
workstreams.delivers: Acceptance pack and independent evidence without framework source ownership
activation_gates: Flagship journey and measurable outcomes are approved
Evidence uses representative sanitized data
The lane remains independent from implementation ownership
publishes: Approved journey and representative-data contract
Usability, accessibility, performance, and outcome evidence
Demo, support, recovery, and residual-risk pack

workstreams.name: Nexus Web Product
workstreams.owns: My Work shell, queue/detail, navigation, status, approvals, notifications, search, and responsive states
workstreams.delivers: Fixture-backed Nexus web application consuming only installable PDS packages
activation_gates: PDS package is installable without a source alias
AI, Workday, and ServiceNow fixtures are versioned
Journey acceptance contract is approved
publishes: Built Nexus web artifact
Package and fixture compatibility lock
Responsive, accessibility, interaction, and visual evidence

workstreams.name: Trust, Runtime Operations, and Observability
workstreams.owns: Agent identity, delegated identity, audit, kill switch, OpenTelemetry, SIEM integration, resilience, and deployment evidence
workstreams.delivers: Operational overlay, dashboards, security evidence, and recovery drills
activation_gates: Baseline trust obligations are already present in producer contracts
Aggregate deployment topology is frozen
Operational evidence can be bound to exact build artifacts
publishes: Operational dashboards and alert routes
Identity, audit, kill-switch, privacy, and SIEM evidence
Load, dependency-failure, recovery, and rollback drills
